evidence.P1: Becoming the One ev-023->ev-032 cites Morpheus capture not in its chain; Believer ev-020->ev-022 and Crew ev-003->ev-019 are and-then without same-plot enablement; Matrix ev-020->ev-045 leaps over trap/betrayal to code-vision
evidence.P2: Each plot holds one stance: Becoming the One on Identity Anderson vs One, Believer on Faith vs proof, Love on love-as-faith, Crew on Freedom vs control, Matrix on Truth vs comfortable lie — no plot is a general retelling
evidence.P3: Becoming the One omits ev-011 Born Into Real World rebirth; Matrix omits ev-023 trap rewrite; Believer pads ev-020 steak-bargain half and Love pads ev-045 Smith-destruction as love proof
evidence.P4: All arcs close: Becoming the One ev-004 doubt to ev-047 flight, Believer ev-014 declaration to ev-045 confirmation, Love ev-004 selection to ev-047 mutual kiss, Crew ev-001 exposure to ev-045 fear, Matrix ev-005 lie to ev-047 transcendence
evidence.P5: Heavy reuse but reframed: Becoming the One shares ev-016/032/045 with Believer and Love and ev-010/045/047 with Matrix, rehashing jump, red-pill and code-vision beats under different dilemma labels

raw.commentary: Thematically disciplined and arc-complete, but causal integrity is weakened by cross-plot dependencies and and-then jumps, membership has omissions/padding, and event reuse creates moderate redundancy despite distinct framings.
